array_transport: Exact100x10x400 C-order little-endian float32 source profile; output128-byte NPY headers. No value conversion or reduction.

host_data_read_passes.other: bounded pool/gold/source/output metadata and EOF reservations

host_memory: Transport is streamed but native capture retains bounded model/base64 buffers; hostRSS is not measured bysourcecontrols. Real host/image/cgroup/memory adequacy is an explicit missing runtime prerequisite.
model_cap_rationale: 512MiB exceeds complete training array plusmetadata, permitting a lossless exemplar policy without forced shrinkage. It is an explicit finite resource profile, not empirical adequacy.
native_logical_inputs: One full mounted training input pass +fourquerypasses +one sealed model pass reserved per fold. Native repeated reads/page cache/physical I/O are not measured or capped by this logical allowance.
no_model_accumulation: One fitmodel renamed in samefold, no extra fitcopy; all model/query/training bodies absent before next fold. Retain receipts and final predictions only.
physical_bound_kind: Conditional policy allowance, not filesystem worst-case proof. Live/terminal allocated-size and20GiBfloor+freshOTHER guards fail closed. Durable retirement precedes next-stagecapacity credit.
source_physical_store: One canonical store already held before selection; existing bytes remain charged in disk occupancy. The stage does not delete or refund canonical data or original MAT files.
